data.long_meaning: The name Harshman is derived from Old English words 'har' meaning 'strong' and 'man' meaning 'man'. It is a name that evokes strength, courage, and power. The name Harshman carries the meaning “Strong, Man” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Harshman usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, man and live with faith, good character and purpose.

This name continues to carry a sense of nobility and bravery in Anglo-Saxon cultures.
